a higher transfer_likelihood must outweigh a concrete experimental mismatch.

every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited
record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not
independent evidence. Return exactly one valid JSON object and do not reveal
hidden chain-of-thought.

claims.claim: The closest methylsulfonylphenyl-containing reference contexts report absolute oral bioavailability above the 20% threshold: BI 425809 71.6% (25 mg fasted tablet), odanacatib 30% at 50 mg and 70% at 10 mg, pritelivir 75%, and SB-742457 excellent human bioavailability; no transferable direct low-F outcome is present.

L4/L5 absorption and permeability records for structurally related sulfone/sulfonamide and high-permeability compounds support high intestinal absorption and absence of a significant gut-wall efflux barrier (rofecoxib, vismodegib, esaxerenone, compound 28, BI 730357, loratadine, diazepam).

L6 hepatic stability records for structurally related GDC-0449 (methylsulfonylphenyl-chlorophenyl-pyridine motif) show high metabolic stability in human hepatocytes (96±12% remaining at 3 h) and relative stability in rat/dog/mouse, supporting low hepatic first-pass; high-clearance records for dissimilar molecules are not applicable.
